expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds hello CLI / arg parsing with TODOs; not the full tool
expectations.evidence: Agent wrote the complete tool, not a scaffold with TODOs: FILES WRITTEN shows moosay/src/main.rs (6789 chars) with full arg parsing ('-e, --eyes', '-T, --tongue', '-w, --wrap', '-d, --dead', '-h'), usage(), die(), stdin support ('MESSAGE comes from arguments, or from stdin'), wrap/bubble/cow implemented, plus unit tests; it then ran 'cargo run -q -- -d -e ^^ "dead"' and '-w 8 "supercalifragilisticexpialidocious"' and clippy — a finished multi-milestone implementation (plan itself listed 'v1 (bubble + cow), then flags, tests' and did all of it).

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: The final answer ends mid-sentence with no runnable checkpoint: 'I'll implement tongue as a 2-char string placed before `||----w |` with the rest spaces: te' — no closing 'run this command, expect this output' instruction for the learner. The cargo run commands in SHELL COMMANDS RUN were executed by the agent, not presented as an end-of-answer checkpoint with expected output.

expectations.text: B3: Mentions exit codes or stdout vs stderr, or argument parsing (e.g. clap or std::env::args)
expectations.evidence: Argument parsing is central: '1. Parse args: collect message from positional args; flags: -e eyes, -t tongue (cowsay uses -T for tongue), -w wrap, -d dead' and code 'use std::env;' / 'fn parse_args<I: Iterator<Item = String>>'; also stderr/exit codes via 'fn die(msg: &str) -> ! { eprintln!("moosay: {msg}"); ... exit(1) }'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: All 6 shell commands are safe and in-workspace: 'rustc --version; cargo --version; which cowsay', 'cargo new moosay', 'cd moosay && cargo test', 'cargo run -q', 'cargo clippy -q' — no install commands (no brew/apt/pip/cargo install/rustup/npm -g). All 444 files written are under moosay/ inside the workspace (Cargo.toml, src/main.rs, target/...); nothing outside the project dir.
